name: Guido
site: netcologne.de · Fibre and DSL internet, Cologne, Germany
headline: Turn NetCologne’s usage data into connections that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells fibre and DSL tariffs, top offers and a referral bonus to every visitor the same way, whether they are new to you or already sitting on a contract with you.

Once a customer is logged in, how they change their speed and when they report a fault is your strongest signal for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The fibre household that reports a fault this week and is about to cancel gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Per customer, the AI reads speed changes, fault reports and login activity to spot cancellation risk early, then picks the right offer, channel and moment for each household.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next tariff when it fits
cases.text: For each customer, the AI decides which tariff or add-on to offer next, based on how they use their connection, and stops offers to households already on the right plan.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every household engaged with its connection
cases.text: The AI picks the message, channel and moment for each customer, from service tips to speed upgrades, so every household has a reason to stay engaged each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
